name: codex-cloud-ready
description: Teach repositories how to install and test themselves so GitHub @codex fixes can run reliably in Codex Cloud.

interface.longDescription: Automatic review finds the issue. Codex Cloud Ready teaches the repository how to install dependencies and run tests so @codex can fix that issue in the same pull request.
defaultPrompt: Use $setup-codex-cloud to make this repository ready for GitHub @codex fixes. Explain the setup in plain language and verify the result.
Use $verify-codex-cloud to verify this repository's cloud readiness.
